dialogues.en: It's possible.
dialogues.text: It's possible.

dialogues.jp:
人気のない桜公園を歩く。まだ時間はそう遅く
はないのに、なぜか誰もいない。
dialogues.en:
Instead of Sakura, I might be falling in love with Nemu,
Kotori, Miharu, Mako, or Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
Instead of Sakura, I might be falling in love with Nemu,
Kotori, Miharu, Mako, or Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
いや、この公園に入ってから、なぜかなんの気
配も感じない。
dialogues.en: I might be living with a maid with cat ears on her head.
dialogues.text: I might be living with a maid with cat ears on her head.

dialogues.jp:
どこにいてもある、遠くで走る車の音や、虫の
鳴き声ひとつ聞こえない。
dialogues.en: I could be just an ordinary student without anyone to love.
dialogues.text: I could be just an ordinary student without anyone to love.

dialogues.jp: 「……人払いでもしてるのか？」
dialogues.en:
On the other hand, I could've had the magic power to kill
somebody instead of making a Japanese snack, and I might
have been fighting with aliens.
dialogues.text:
On the other hand, I could've had the magic power to kill
somebody instead of making a Japanese snack, and I might
have been fighting with aliens.

dialogues.jp: 携帯電話を見る。４月２９日――昭和の日。
dialogues.en: I'm in just one of infinite possibilities and combinations.
dialogues.text: I'm in just one of infinite possibilities and combinations.

dialogues.jp:
ストラップに指をかけて携帯を回すと、暗がり
の中に明るい円が浮かび上がる。
特に意味があるわけではない。
dialogues.en: "It's too much to think about."
dialogues.text: "It's too much to think about."

dialogues.jp:
ただ、なんとなく、さくらはあの木の側にいる
と確信したし、やるべきことが決まっていたか
ら、焦りが消えているのだ。
dialogues.en: There is no answer.
dialogues.text: There is no answer.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……めんどいな」
dialogues.en: I can only make Japanese snacks. I am a bullshit magician.
dialogues.text: I can only make Japanese snacks. I am a bullshit magician.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが目を覚ましたら、今の俺は消えるのか
も知れない。
dialogues.en: I have a younger sister who doesn't cook.
dialogues.text: I have a younger sister who doesn't cook.

dialogues.jp:
夢とやらが覚めたとき、そこにいる俺が誰なの
か。それは分からないけれど、今の俺のことを
覚えていないのは確かだろう。
dialogues.en: I have friends who always talk nonsense.
dialogues.text: I have friends who always talk nonsense.

dialogues.jp:
そう考え出すと、さくらを好きな俺も、さくら
の味方をする俺も、あくまで夢の作り出した幻
想なのかも知れないのか。
dialogues.en: I had a hard time before the exams.
dialogues.text: I had a hard time before the exams.

dialogues.jp: あくまで可能性のひとつ。
dialogues.en: I'm a little awkward.
dialogues.text: I'm a little awkward.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの代わりに、音夢やことり、美春、眞子
や萌先輩と結ばれている俺もいるかも知れない
のだ。
dialogues.en: I don't like boring stuff.
dialogues.text: I don't like boring stuff.

dialogues.jp:
猫耳のメイドさんと暮らしている可能性だって
あるわけだ。
dialogues.en: Moreover, I hate hassle.
dialogues.text: Moreover, I hate hassle.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら恋愛には縁のない、平凡なだけの
学生だったのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: And finding 1000 yen on the street would make me happier.
dialogues.text: And finding 1000 yen on the street would make me happier.

dialogues.jp:
もしくは和菓子なんかじゃなくて、人を殺せる
ような魔法を持って、異星人と戦っていたのか
も知れない。
dialogues.en: I love Sakura.
dialogues.text: I love Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
無限の可能性と、無限の組み合わせの結果が今
なのだ。
dialogues.en: Very much.
dialogues.text: Very much.

dialogues.en: That's me who always thinks of stupid stuff like this.
dialogues.text: That's me who always thinks of stupid stuff like this.

dialogues.jp: 「……考えるだけ面倒だな」
dialogues.en: And here I am.
dialogues.text: And here I am.

dialogues.jp: 答えなんてない。
dialogues.en: "Are you listening, Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Are you listening, Sakura?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は和菓子しか作れない、出来そこないの魔法
使いだ。
dialogues.en:
I muttered, looking up at the cherry blossoms that never
die.
dialogues.text:
I muttered, looking up at the cherry blossoms that never
die.

dialogues.jp: 家事の出来ない妹がいて。
dialogues.en: If I can project my thoughts, I'm sure she can hear me.
dialogues.text: If I can project my thoughts, I'm sure she can hear me.

dialogues.jp: いつもバカばっかり出来る友達がいて。
dialogues.en:
"It's nothing to do with a dream you have. We're living
right now - nobody forced us to do that."
dialogues.text:
"It's nothing to do with a dream you have. We're living
right now - nobody forced us to do that."

dialogues.jp: テストの前に頭を悩ませて。
dialogues.en:
"Whether they forced us or not, it'll be a big mess when
they reset like a game."
dialogues.text:
"Whether they forced us or not, it'll be a big mess when
they reset like a game."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと間が悪くて。
dialogues.en:
"And you think it's your fault, and want to start it over
again, but that's a stupid idea."
dialogues.text:
"And you think it's your fault, and want to start it over
again, but that's a stupid idea."

dialogues.jp: 退屈なのが嫌いで。
dialogues.en: Rustle...
dialogues.text: Rustle...

dialogues.jp: でも、面倒事はもっと嫌いで。
dialogues.en:
The cherry tree sways in the corner of the park, even though
there's no wind.
dialogues.text:
The cherry tree sways in the corner of the park, even though
there's no wind.

dialogues.jp: 道端で１０００円でも拾えば大喜びして。
dialogues.en: "You're only a kid."
dialogues.text: "You're only a kid."

dialogues.jp: さくらが好きで。
dialogues.en: Rustle, Rustle...
dialogues.text: Rustle, Rustle...

dialogues.jp: 大好きで。
dialogues.en: "You even don't have any curves."
dialogues.text: "You even don't have any curves."

dialogues.jp: こんな面倒なことを考えているのが俺だ。
dialogues.en: Rustle, Rustle...
dialogues.text: Rustle, Rustle...

dialogues.jp: それが結果だ。
dialogues.en:
"You're a shorty and a snob, and on top of that, you lied to
me for this long."
dialogues.text:
"You're a shorty and a snob, and on top of that, you lied to
me for this long."

dialogues.jp: 「聞いているんだろう、さくら」
dialogues.en: Rustle, Rustle, Rustle...!!
dialogues.text: Rustle, Rustle, Rustle...!!

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜を見上げて呟く。
dialogues.en:
The tree vibrates into the woods as if it were responding to
my word.
dialogues.text:
The tree vibrates into the woods as if it were responding to
my word.

dialogues.jp:
想いが伝わるのならば、あいつに俺の言葉は届
いている。
dialogues.en: "Funny girl..."
dialogues.text: "Funny girl..."

dialogues.jp:
「夢だとかなんだとかは関係ないんだ。俺達は
　こうして生きているし、別に誰かに強制され
　たわけじゃない」
dialogues.en: I step in the woods with a grin.
dialogues.text: I step in the woods with a grin.

dialogues.jp:
「強制されていようがなんだろうが、ゲームみ
　たいにリセットされちゃ困るんだよ」
dialogues.en: I laugh, thinking that she sounds better than I thought.
dialogues.text: I laugh, thinking that she sounds better than I thought.

dialogues.jp:
「それを、自分のせいにして抱え込んで、初め
　からやり直そうなんて言ってる、お前がバカ
　なんだ」
ざわ――。
dialogues.en: "Aaahhh... ooohhh..."
dialogues.text: "Aaahhh... ooohhh..."

dialogues.jp: 風もないのに、公園の一角で桜が揺れた。
dialogues.en: "Haha!"
dialogues.text: "Haha!"

dialogues.jp: 「……ガキのくせに」
dialogues.en: It's kind of fun to see.
dialogues.text: It's kind of fun to see.

dialogues.jp: ざわざわ――。
dialogues.en:
Leaning against the cherry tree, I see Sakura, looking
distraught.
dialogues.text:
Leaning against the cherry tree, I see Sakura, looking
distraught.

dialogues.jp: 「……おうとつもないし」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp: ざわざわざわ――。

「……チビで可愛げがなくて、ずっと俺に嘘を
　ついてたくせに」
dialogues.en:
If I talk with Sakura and pretend nothing happened, I wonder
if all of this will become just a dream.
dialogues.text:
If I talk with Sakura and pretend nothing happened, I wonder
if all of this will become just a dream.

dialogues.jp: ざわざわざわざわ――！！
dialogues.en: "Here you are."
dialogues.text: "Here you are."

dialogues.jp:
言葉ひとつひとつに反応するように、林の奥へ
と震えが伝染していく。
dialogues.en:
When I hear Sakura's sad voice, I become keenly aware that
this is reality.
dialogues.text:
When I hear Sakura's sad voice, I become keenly aware that
this is reality.

dialogues.jp: 「……面白いやつ」
dialogues.en:
Even so, I try to smile, and I stop a little distance from
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Even so, I try to smile, and I stop a little distance from
Sakura.

dialogues.jp: ニヤリ、と笑って林に足を踏み入れる。
dialogues.en: "What a beautiful night."
dialogues.text: "What a beautiful night."

dialogues.jp:
思ったより元気そうじゃないか、って。ついつ
い笑ってしまったのだ。
dialogues.en: The moon is full in the sky.
dialogues.text: The moon is full in the sky.

dialogues.en: "This is the perfect night to meet a witch."
dialogues.text: "This is the perfect night to meet a witch."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゅうう……ぅぅ……」
ちょっと面白い。
dialogues.en: "Get up."
dialogues.text: "Get up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm... I'm already up..."
dialogues.text: "Hm... I'm already up..."

dialogues.jp:
もしここで、何事もなかったかのようにさくら
に声をかけたら、実は全て夢だったことに出来
るのだろうか――なんて考えていた。
dialogues.en: "You're not!"
dialogues.text: "You're not!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「来ちゃったね」

それでも、さくらの悲しげな声に、これが｛・・／現実｝
なんだって痛感する。
dialogues.en: "It's still night."
dialogues.text: "It's still night."

dialogues.jp:
それでも、なんとか笑みを浮かべながら、俺は
さくらから少し離れた場所で立ち止まる。
dialogues.en: Sakura looks up at the sky as well.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks up at the sky as well.

dialogues.jp: 「いい夜だ」
dialogues.en: And, she runs up to me in tears.
dialogues.text: And, she runs up to me in tears.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Ooohhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ooohhh..."

dialogues.jp: 見上げた空にはまあるいお月様が浮いている。
dialogues.en: "Do you need a charging?"
dialogues.text: "Do you need a charging?"

dialogues.jp: 「魔法使いが会うにはちょうどいい」
dialogues.en: I don't know how long I've been here.
dialogues.text: I don't know how long I've been here.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en:
When I stroked her beautiful blond hair, I find tangles and
knots in there.
dialogues.text:
When I stroked her beautiful blond hair, I find tangles and
knots in there.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「起きろよ」
dialogues.en: "Do you still like me?"
dialogues.text: "Do you still like me?"

dialogues.jp: さくらも空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: "Of course I do."
dialogues.text: "Of course I do."

dialogues.jp:
そして、ジワジワと涙を浮かべて、俺のところ
に走りよってくる。
dialogues.en:
I smile while combing her hair with my hand even I know it's
a futile effort.
dialogues.text:
I smile while combing her hair with my hand even I know it's
a futile effort.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Do you think you will love me forever?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think you will love me forever?"

dialogues.jp: ここにどれだけ、何日の間いたのだろうか。
dialogues.en: "Yes, I will."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I will."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……まだボクのこと好き？」
dialogues.en: "Whose feelings are you talking about now?"
dialogues.text: "Whose feelings are you talking about now?"

dialogues.jp:
無駄な努力なんだろうが、指で髪をすいてやり
ながら小さく笑う。
dialogues.en: "A blue gill."
dialogues.text: "A blue gill."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ずっと好きかな？」
dialogues.en: "What?!"
dialogues.text: "What?!"

dialogues.jp: ぐるぐると頭を揺らしてさくらが俺から離れる。
dialogues.en: Sakura steps apart from me, shaking her head.
dialogues.text: Sakura steps apart from me, shaking her head.

dialogues.jp: 「信じろよ」
dialogues.en: "Believe me."
dialogues.text: "Believe me."

dialogues.jp:
「お前は俺が変なこと言うことまで自分の夢だ
　なんて言うのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think my joke is in your dream, too?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think my joke is in your dream, too?"

dialogues.jp: 肩をすくませてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I sigh and shrug my shoulders.
dialogues.text: I sigh and shrug my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「頭いいのも、先生になれたのも、おけらだっ
　てあめんぼだって、生きてるのだって夢じゃ
　ない」
dialogues.en:
"Being smart, becoming a teacher, even worms, water, and
living -- these aren't a dream."
dialogues.text:
"Being smart, becoming a teacher, even worms, water, and
living -- these aren't a dream."

dialogues.jp: 「俺がお前を好きなのも夢じゃない」
dialogues.en: "The fact I love you isn't a dream, either."
dialogues.text: "The fact I love you isn't a dream, either."

dialogues.jp:
我ながら、頭の中でネジがすっとんでしまった
ような感じだ。
dialogues.en: I feel like such an idiot saying this kind of shit.
dialogues.text: I feel like such an idiot saying this kind of shit.

dialogues.jp: どうしても熱くなれない。
dialogues.en: I can't get going with no reason.
dialogues.text: I can't get going with no reason.

dialogues.jp:
いや、違う……あんまりにもバカげた話で、実
際は大笑いをしたいのを堪えたいのだろう。
dialogues.en: No, that's wrong... it's too absurd for me to laugh about.
dialogues.text: No, that's wrong... it's too absurd for me to laugh about.

dialogues.jp:
「ははは……いや、こんなこと言うのは、俺じゃ
　ないかな？」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha... Well, I sound a different person."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha... Well, I sound a different person."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんん……お兄ちゃんは」
dialogues.en: "Well, you are..."
dialogues.text: "Well, you are..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんは、ボクの大好きなお兄ちゃんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"You are most important person in the world to me,
oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"You are most important person in the world to me,
oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 手を繋ぎながら歩いているさくらを見下ろす。
dialogues.en: Hand in hand, I look down at Sakura.
dialogues.text: Hand in hand, I look down at Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
桜を枯らす前に――俺には理解できない心境な
のだろうが、一緒に公園を散歩したいと言い出
したのだ。
dialogues.en:
She asked me to walk together before the cherry blossoms
die, as if I didn't know what she's feeling.
dialogues.text:
She asked me to walk together before the cherry blossoms
die, as if I didn't know what she's feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、にゃはははは」
dialogues.en: "Well... Nyahahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Well... Nyahahaha..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだお前は……」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、ちょっと、ちらほらと夜の公園にはカッ
　プルさんが多いんで」
dialogues.en: "Well, there are a few lovers in the park here and there."
dialogues.text: "Well, there are a few lovers in the park here and there."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」
dialogues.en: "Huhh."
dialogues.text: "Huhh."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！　なんでため息をつくの！？」
dialogues.en: "Hm! Why did you give a sigh?"
dialogues.text: "Hm! Why did you give a sigh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「安心しろ……」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry."

dialogues.jp: 首を振りつつ夜空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I look up at the sky, shaking my head.
dialogues.text: I look up at the sky, shaking my head.

dialogues.jp: 「俺とお前は、誘拐犯と子供にしか見えん」
dialogues.en: "You and me look like a child and a kidnapper."
dialogues.text: "You and me look like a child and a kidnapper."

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅっと指を握る力が強くなり、さくらが頭を
俺に寄せてくる。
dialogues.en: She makes her grip tighter, then rests her head on me.
dialogues.text: She makes her grip tighter, then rests her head on me.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「このままさらって欲しいかも……」
dialogues.en: "I wouldn't mind if you kidnap me now."
dialogues.text: "I wouldn't mind if you kidnap me now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Papa..."
dialogues.text: "Papa..."

dialogues.jp: 手と手を握り合う。
dialogues.en: We grasp each other's hands.
dialogues.text: We grasp each other's hands.

dialogues.jp: 「いいから、ここまで来たら頑張れよ！！」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you've come this far, keep going!!"
dialogues.text: "Well, if you've come this far, keep going!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Whaaa!!"
dialogues.text: "Whaaa!!"

dialogues.jp:
本当に誘拐犯にでもなった気分で、にゃ〜
にゃ〜わめくさくらを引きずっていく。
dialogues.en:
I drag Sakura along, as she cries and screams as if I were
really kidnapping her.
dialogues.text:
I drag Sakura along, as she cries and screams as if I were
really kidnapping her.

dialogues.jp:
「なんでこう、お前にはここぞって時の情緒っ
　てもんが――……？」
dialogues.en:
"I can't believe that you always act like this, even at
serious times like this."
dialogues.text:
"I can't believe that you always act like this, even at
serious times like this."

dialogues.jp: 言葉を切って口に手を当てる。
dialogues.en: I say that and put my hand over her mouth.
dialogues.text: I say that and put my hand over her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない……」
dialogues.en: "No, nothing..."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing..."

dialogues.jp: なんだか音夢みたいなことを言ってるのは俺か。
dialogues.en: I know I'm talking like Nemu now.
dialogues.text: I know I'm talking like Nemu now.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃはは……変なお兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Nyahahaha... you're so weird, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Nyahahaha... you're so weird, oniichan."

dialogues.jp:
その冗談めかした目の奥に、本当に怖がってい
る光があることも分かっていた。
dialogues.en: I know there's a real fear behind her joke.
dialogues.text: I know there's a real fear behind her joke.

dialogues.jp: 手の震えも。汗も。
dialogues.en: Her trembling hands and sweat.
dialogues.text: Her trembling hands and sweat.

dialogues.jp: さくらの痛みなんて想像することも出来ない。
dialogues.en: I can't imagine how much pain she's in.
dialogues.text: I can't imagine how much pain she's in.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なにか悟れてしまうような言葉をあげら
れるほど大人ではなく、抱きしめてやるのも恥
ずかしくて……似合ってない気がして。
dialogues.en:
I'm not mature enough to give her comforting words, and feel
so embarrassed to hold her. I'm not good at those.
dialogues.text:
I'm not mature enough to give her comforting words, and feel
so embarrassed to hold her. I'm not good at those.

dialogues.jp: だから俺は必死にさくらの手を握り締めていた。
dialogues.en: So, all I can do is just hold her hand.
dialogues.text: So, all I can do is just hold her hand.

dialogues.jp: さくらも握り返してくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura squeezes back.
dialogues.text: Sakura squeezes back.

dialogues.jp: ――これも意味のない散歩だった。
dialogues.en: This was a futile walk as well.
dialogues.text: This was a futile walk as well.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクの始まりの日は、多分、ここだったんだ」
dialogues.en: "I believe this is the beginning of everything."
dialogues.text: "I believe this is the beginning of everything."

dialogues.jp:
呟くさくらに目を向けて、そうかもな、と自分
にしか聞こえない声で呟く。
dialogues.en: Looking at Sakura, I mutter to myself that it could be true.
dialogues.text: Looking at Sakura, I mutter to myself that it could be true.

dialogues.jp:
あの日、さくらが俺に別れを告げた日から始まっ
たのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I think the day when Sakura said good-bye to me was the
beginning of her new life.
dialogues.text:
I think the day when Sakura said good-bye to me was the
beginning of her new life.

dialogues.jp: 「……どうするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you going to do?"
dialogues.text: "What are you going to do?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらに顔を向けると、なんのことだか伝わら
なかったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I look at Sakura, and she looks like she doesn't know what
I'm talking about.
dialogues.text:
I look at Sakura, and she looks like she doesn't know what
I'm talking about.

dialogues.jp: 「桜を枯らすにはどうするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "How do you make cherry blossoms go away?"
dialogues.text: "How do you make cherry blossoms go away?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「願えばいいんだと思うよ……心の底から」
dialogues.en:
"I think you just keep wishing from the bottom of your
heart."
dialogues.text:
"I think you just keep wishing from the bottom of your
heart."

dialogues.jp: ぺた、と木に手を当ててさくらが空を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Sakura puts her hand on the tree, and looks up the sky.
dialogues.text: Sakura puts her hand on the tree, and looks up the sky.

dialogues.jp:
それはちょうど、もうひとりの夢の中のさくら
が消えた光景と似ていた。
dialogues.en:
It reminds me of the other Sakura in the dream, who
disappeared.
dialogues.text:
It reminds me of the other Sakura in the dream, who
disappeared.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さぁ？」
dialogues.en: "I don't know."
dialogues.text: "I don't know."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 頷いて、さくらを抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I nod and hold her.
dialogues.text: I nod and hold her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「充電しておけよ」
dialogues.en: "You should get charged."
dialogues.text: "You should get charged."

dialogues.jp: しっかりと、痛いくらいにお互いを抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I hold her as tight as I can.
dialogues.text: I hold her as tight as I can.

dialogues.jp: 「何パーセントくらい欲しい？」
dialogues.en: "How much do you need to charge this time?"
dialogues.text: "How much do you need to charge this time?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……２５６パーセント」
dialogues.en: "256 percent..."
dialogues.text: "256 percent..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。終わったら言えよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Let me know when it's done."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Let me know when it's done."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp: じっ、と舞い散る桜の中で抱きあう。
dialogues.en: We embrace, while cherry petals flutter in the wind.
dialogues.text: We embrace, while cherry petals flutter in the wind.

dialogues.jp: 見上げた月がじりじり、と昇り、沈んでゆく。
dialogues.en: The moon rises in the sky, and then goes away.
dialogues.text: The moon rises in the sky, and then goes away.

dialogues.jp: 腕が｛しび／痺｝れて感覚も薄れている。
dialogues.en: My arms are numb with a stinging sensation.
dialogues.text: My arms are numb with a stinging sensation.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、さくら……面白い言葉があるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sakura... Have you ever heard this before?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sakura... Have you ever heard this before?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「魔法使いは、人を本当に好きになると魔法が
　使えなくなる――って」
dialogues.en:
"When a witch falls in love with someone, you will lose your
magic power."
dialogues.text:
"When a witch falls in love with someone, you will lose your
magic power."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
それは、ばあちゃんの言葉だったが、ようやく
意味が分かった。
dialogues.en: My grandma used to say that, and I know what she meant now.
dialogues.text: My grandma used to say that, and I know what she meant now.

dialogues.jp: 魔法使いが魔法を捨てる――。
dialogues.en: A witch gives up the magic power.
dialogues.text: A witch gives up the magic power.

dialogues.jp:
それはなにも魔法に限ったことじゃなくて、お
互いの本当の姿を見つめるということか。
dialogues.en:
It's not all about the magic, but about seeing the reality
in each other.
dialogues.text:
It's not all about the magic, but about seeing the reality
in each other.

dialogues.jp: 職業とか上辺じゃなくて――。
dialogues.en: It's not about your career or your appearance.
dialogues.text: It's not about your career or your appearance.

dialogues.jp: 俺を見上げるさくらに苦笑を返す。
dialogues.en: Sakura looks up at me, and I give her a sad smile.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks up at me, and I give her a sad smile.

dialogues.jp: あの人がそこまで考えてたわけないな。
dialogues.en: I don't think she expected this then.
dialogues.text: I don't think she expected this then.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら、今日のこの状況を知っていての、
直接的な言葉かも知れないし。
dialogues.en:
By some chance, she mentioned it, knowing this situation
would happen to me eventually.
dialogues.text:
By some chance, she mentioned it, knowing this situation
would happen to me eventually.

dialogues.jp: 自分で考えろってことだ。
dialogues.en: In fact, she wanted to say I should think by myself.
dialogues.text: In fact, she wanted to say I should think by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……もういいよ」
dialogues.en: "That's enough."
dialogues.text: "That's enough."

dialogues.jp:
俺の胸に額を当てて、そのまま押し出すように
さくらが木のほうに足を下げる。
dialogues.en:
Putting her forehead on my chest, Sakura puts her feet on
the trunk.
dialogues.text:
Putting her forehead on my chest, Sakura puts her feet on
the trunk.

dialogues.jp: 「……手が痛い」
dialogues.en: "My hands hurt."
dialogues.text: "My hands hurt."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「充電しすぎで壊れそうだよ」
dialogues.en: "I feel like I'm going to explode with so much charge."
dialogues.text: "I feel like I'm going to explode with so much charge."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「何パーセントたまった？」
dialogues.en: "What percentage are you up to?"
dialogues.text: "What percentage are you up to?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……愛情１０００万パーセントだよ！」
dialogues.en: "Hm... Passion 1000000 percent!!"
dialogues.text: "Hm... Passion 1000000 percent!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see."

dialogues.jp: 思わず笑ってしまう。
dialogues.en: I laugh in spite of myself.
dialogues.text: I laugh in spite of myself.

dialogues.jp:
滅茶苦茶な数字だが、それだけあれば、桜だっ
て枯れるだろう。
dialogues.en:
The number is topsy-turvy, but I'm sure she can make all the
cherry blossoms go away.
dialogues.text:
The number is topsy-turvy, but I'm sure she can make all the
cherry blossoms go away.

dialogues.jp: さくらが木に寄り添う。
dialogues.en: Sakura leans against the tree.
dialogues.text: Sakura leans against the tree.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「１こだけ、新しい約束してもいいかな？」
dialogues.en: "Can you make one more promise to me?"
dialogues.text: "Can you make one more promise to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「桜が枯れて、それでもまだボクを好きだっ
　たら、いっぱい、いっぱ〜いキスして欲し
　い……」
dialogues.en:
"After the cherry blossoms die, and if you're still in love
with me, I want you to kiss me a lot..."
dialogues.text:
"After the cherry blossoms die, and if you're still in love
with me, I want you to kiss me a lot..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……面倒だな」
dialogues.en: "It sounds too much work for me."
dialogues.text: "It sounds too much work for me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「約束して……誰でもないボクと」
dialogues.en: "Can you promise it to me?"
dialogues.text: "Can you promise it to me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……必要ないさ」
dialogues.en: "I don't need to."
dialogues.text: "I don't need to."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「これから毎日、嫌だって言ったってしてやる
　んだから」
dialogues.en:
"Because I'll do that every day even if you don't want me
to."
dialogues.text:
"Because I'll do that every day even if you don't want me
to."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マジ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マジマジ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, very sure."
dialogues.text: "Yes, very sure."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あは♪」
dialogues.en: "Uh-huh!"
dialogues.text: "Uh-huh!"

dialogues.jp:
とろけるような笑顔を浮かべて、さくらが１度
だけ振り返る。
dialogues.en: Sakura turns back once with her sweet smile.
dialogues.text: Sakura turns back once with her sweet smile.

dialogues.jp: 目を閉じて祈る。
dialogues.en: I pray with my eyes closed.
dialogues.text: I pray with my eyes closed.

dialogues.jp: どうか、俺が俺でありますように。
dialogues.en: Please, let me go back to who I was.
dialogues.text: Please, let me go back to who I was.

dialogues.jp: どうか――。
dialogues.en: Please...
dialogues.text: Please...

dialogues.jp: どうかどうか――。
dialogues.en: Please......
dialogues.text: Please......

dialogues.jp: 俺達の世界が、当たり前でありますように――。
dialogues.en: Please, let our world go back to how it used to be.
dialogues.text: Please, let our world go back to how it used to be.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……今までありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: やさしく、木に抱きつく。
dialogues.en: She cuddles the tree gently.
dialogues.text: She cuddles the tree gently.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「君は、ボクのことを一生懸命守ってくれたん
　だよね」
dialogues.en: "You kept me going for a long time."
dialogues.text: "You kept me going for a long time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「わがまま聞いてくれてありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for understanding my selfishness."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for understanding my selfishness."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと咲いててくれてありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for keeping the flowers in bloom."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for keeping the flowers in bloom."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「たくさんの思い出と、たくさんの夢をありが
　とう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for a lot of memories and dreams."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for a lot of memories and dreams."

dialogues.jp: こぽこぽ、と夢が水のように幹を流れている音。
dialogues.en: I hear the sound of water spilling down on the trunk.
dialogues.text: I hear the sound of water spilling down on the trunk.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だから……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 見上げた桜の花びらが、ぼう、と青く光る。
dialogues.en: The cherry petals up on the tree are gleaming blue.
dialogues.text: The cherry petals up on the tree are gleaming blue.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクのわがままを最後まで聞いてくれて――」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for understanding my selfishness."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for understanding my selfishness."

dialogues.jp:
いつのまにか月は沈み、かすかに、空が夜明け
の金色の光を帯びだしている。
dialogues.en:
The moon hazes over, and I see the golden gleam of the dawn
approaching.
dialogues.text:
The moon hazes over, and I see the golden gleam of the dawn
approaching.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「また来年」
dialogues.en: "See you next year."
dialogues.text: "See you next year."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これから先もずっとずっと……」
dialogues.en: "Let's keep in touch......"
dialogues.text: "Let's keep in touch......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……また、春に会おうね」
dialogues.en: "......See you next spring."
dialogues.text: "......See you next spring."

dialogues.jp: ◆桜、枯れる◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.en:
I walk through the deserted park full of cherry blossom
trees. I don't know why nobody's here even though the night
is still young.
dialogues.text:
I walk through the deserted park full of cherry blossom
trees. I don't know why nobody's here even though the night
is still young.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、あの場所にきっといると思った。さ
くらの云う、目の覚めた時、夢が終わった時、
俺の身に何が起こるのか……それは分からない。
dialogues.en:
Since I arrived in this park, it's felt like a different
world.
dialogues.text:
Since I arrived in this park, it's felt like a different
world.

dialogues.jp:
｛いま／現在｝、さくらのことが好きな俺が、魔法による
ものなのか、そうでないのか。そんなことに確
信は持てない。
dialogues.en:
I don't even hear the sound of cars in the distance or
insects.
dialogues.text:
I don't even hear the sound of cars in the distance or
insects.

dialogues.jp:
どのような未来も、全ては無限の可能性の一つ
でしか無い。考えるだけ、かったるい。答えな
んて無い。
dialogues.en: "Was everyone ordered to leave?"
dialogues.text: "Was everyone ordered to leave?"

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺はさくらを見つけた。やっぱりここ
にいやがった……。
dialogues.en: I look at my cell phone. April 29th -- Green day.
dialogues.text: I look at my cell phone. April 29th -- Green day.

dialogues.jp:
さくらはじっくり、俺から『充電』すると、あ
の桜に寄り添った。
dialogues.en:
When I spin the cell phone with my finger hooked on the
strap, the light looms out of the darkness in a circular
motion.
dialogues.text:
When I spin the cell phone with my finger hooked on the
strap, the light looms out of the darkness in a circular
motion.

dialogues.jp:
そして、さくらは桜が枯れてから、毎日いっぱ
いいっぱいキスするように、約束してくれと言っ
た。
dialogues.en: It doesn't have any special meaning.
dialogues.text: It doesn't have any special meaning.

dialogues.jp: そんなこと……約束するまでもない。
dialogues.en:
I somehow know that Sakura's behind that cherry tree. I feel
so relaxed... maybe because I know what I have to do when I
see her.
dialogues.text:
I somehow know that Sakura's behind that cherry tree. I feel
so relaxed... maybe because I know what I have to do when I
see her.

dialogues.jp:
そして、さくらは祈った。いや、願ったのか
……。
dialogues.en: "Hahh... It's tiring."
dialogues.text: "Hahh... It's tiring."

dialogues.jp: 桜に、これまでのことを感謝し、そして――
dialogues.en: If Sakura wakes up, I might be gone.
dialogues.text: If Sakura wakes up, I might be gone.

dialogues.jp: 謝った。
dialogues.en:
When the dream is over, I don't know who I will be. But I'm
sure I won't remember anything about this moment.
dialogues.text:
When the dream is over, I don't know who I will be. But I'm
sure I won't remember anything about this moment.

dialogues.jp:
あいつにはわかっている。桜にはまた、春に会
える。
dialogues.en:
The thought occurs that it could be just a fantasy that the
dream created, that I, who love Sakura, take Sakura's side.
dialogues.text:
The thought occurs that it could be just a fantasy that the
dream created, that I, who love Sakura, take Sakura's side.
